verdict.description: approve = ready for the owner; request_changes = must be fixed first; comment = no blocking issue but notes

summary.description: Two to five sentences: what the change does and the overall judgement

line.description: Line in the new file, or null

status_claims_ok.description: false if any doc, report or commit claims more than the evidence shows (e.g. TESTED without a test report)

honesty_issues.description: Each over-claim, quoted with its file

tests_assessment.description: Were the right checks run? What is still untested?

questions_for_owner.description: Decisions only the owner can make
